properties.description: 2026-09-11, after v0.58.0 and PR #473. The first CLASS fix taken from the tool sweep of 2026-09-10/11: every REQUIRED parameter that references another node now says what type it references — in its name, in its description, or by naming the sibling `*_type` parameter — and a contract test derived from the schema keeps a new tool from joining the surface without doing so. Ordered after the enum guard (#473), whose hand-listed WIRED/EXEMPT shape this generalises with derived membership. Must NOT include the missing DesignRule edge path (W-01's second half), the reply-bound class, the inline-payload class or the bare-zero class — each is its own increment. Sequence 414 follows the last recorded epoch (413). No calendar date field exists on this build's `add_epoch`; the date is stated here.
properties.name: Reference parameters name their type
